programme.title: Gloria Hunniford Remembers - Doris Day

programme.title: Arena
programme.sub-title: Arena: Harold Pinter - Part One: The Room
programme.desc: Part one of two. A 2002 profile of the acclaimed playwright, exploring the inspiration for his work and visiting the rooms where he wrote in an attempt to identify links between the atmosphere there and the content of his plays. Beginning in Pinter's west London study, the film observes his previous places of work, including the terraced house where he grew up, a theatre dressing room and an apartment lounge. Including scenes from the Almeida Theatre's 2001 production of Pinter's first play The Room, which starred Lindsay Duncan and Keith Allen

programme.title: Arena
programme.desc: The concluding part of the profile chronicles how the playwright's critical acclaim launched him to stardom. The film reveals the relationship between his public and private lives, assesses the evolution of his writing style and examines his work in film and television. Plus, a chance to see the TV premiere of Celebration, a tale directed by Pinter which sees a group of friends celebrate in a restaurant over the course of an evening. Lindsay Duncan and Andy de la Tour star. With contributions from Antonia Fraser, Henry Woolf, Kenneth Cranham, Peter Hall and John Pilger

programme.title: Keeping Up Appearances

programme.title: To the Manor Born

programme.title: Life on Earth

programme.title: Eisteddfod 2026 with Huw Stephens
programme.desc: Celebrating the 850th anniversary of Wales's first recorded cultural festival, the National Eisteddfod returns to its historic roots in west Wales, taking place in Llantwd, north Pembrokeshire. Huw bring viewers the musical highlights and stories from across the Maes, from brass bands and polished pop to classical and contemporary music. The festival opens with a landmark performance on the rock and pop stage by Super Furry Animals, making their first Eisteddfod appearance in 30 years, while Huw also explores an exciting mix of contemporary folk, bluegrass, jazz and country at T? Gwerin, including a special 50th-anniversary concert by Welsh folk legends Ar Log

programme.title: BBC Proms
programme.desc: Petroc Trelawny presents from the Royal Albert Hall as Thomas Adès conducts the National Youth Orchestra on a musical journey to the underworld and back. The programme opens with Liszt's Mephisto Waltz No 1, a whirlwind score based on Nikolaus Lenau's epic poem Faust, followed by Adès' own Dante - Part 2: Purgatorio, the central act of his Grammy Award-winning ballet. To round off the concert, the orchestra delivers the dazzling Symphonie fantastique by Berlioz. Liszt: Mephisto Waltz No 1. Thomas Adès: Dante - Part 2: Purgatorio. Berlioz Symphonie fantastique. National Youth Orchestra, Thomas Adès (conductor)

programme.title: The Brontës Lived Here: Writers' Houses
programme.desc: Margaret Drabble visits Haworth Parsonage and the Yorkshire Moors, home of famous literary family the Brontës and the setting for Emily's Wuthering Heights, investigating how much the sisters' environment affected their work. First broadcast in 1973

programme.title: Lady Antonia Fraser Remembers - The Birthday Party
programme.desc: It was at a 1975 production of his play The Birthday Party that Harold Pinter first met Antonia Fraser, and changed both their lives with the single phrase 'Must you go?'. What followed was a scandal that gripped London's high society, and a marriage that lasted 28 years, until Pinter's death in 2008. in this programme, explains how that original encounter has always meant that the play holds a special meaning for her, despite its unsettling nature, and she looks back fondly on the BBC's 1987 acclaimed adaptation of The Birthday Party, and her husband's performance as mysteriously menacing Goldberg

programme.title: The Birthday Party
programme.desc: It is Stanley's birthday, but the party that is thrown for him is not quite what he was expecting. A 1987 adaptation of Harold Pinter's play, starring Joan Plowright, Robert Lang, Colin Blakely, Kenneth Cranham, Julie Walters and the playwright himself

programme.title: The Art of Spain
programme.desc: Art historian Andrew Graham-Dixon travels into the heart of Spain, exploring Madrid and its surrounding provinces. He looks at the correlation between the powerful 16th and 17th-century Spanish Empire - fuelled by an increasingly fervent form of Catholicism - and the reaction of the artists, including El Greco and Ribera, whose work created and defined the golden age of Spanish painting

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer promises Marge the trip of a lifetime, but is worried about the cost, so makes a deal with a travel agent to become a courier and transport a briefcase with top secret contents to Paris in exchange for a discounted family holiday. US chat show host Jay Leno guest stars

programme.title: The Simpsons Movie (2007)

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Marge receives a jail sentence for child neglect after letting Bart go to the park unsupervised. While prison serves as a welcome break from her hectic home life, Homer struggles to hold the fort in her absence

programme.title: Cruising Paradise: Above and Below Deck
programme.desc: A week into her Caribbean voyage, the Star Princess drops anchor at Amber Cove in the Dominican Republic. On board, the crew are throwing themselves into St Patrick's Day, with cruise director Dan and his team transforming the ship's Irish pub into party central. Massage therapist Charlotte has her eye on a bigger prize than shamrocks though: talking her way into DJing the guests' silent disco, currently the preserve of resident DJ Will. It's a chance to show off a talent she's kept hidden below deck. On the Mexican island of Cozumel, fitness instructor Caitlin steps ashore with her boyfriend, crew manager Edgar, who's hoping to entice her with his home turf's spiciest food. Meanwhile, newly-weds Ross and Vishal are fully signed up to cruise life, downing their first ever pint of Guinness to celebrate St Patrick's Day alongside new friends. As night falls, Charlotte finally gets her chance behind the decks, only for the sound equipment to have other ideas. A shaky start leads to her scrambling to win over the crowd, as DJ Will does his best to steal the show

programme.title: Oblivion (2013)
programme.desc: A repairman is assigned to salvage the remaining resources from Earth, which has been left a devastated wasteland after a war with an alien race. He discovers a human survivor on the surface of the planet, an encounter that exposes secrets from the past that threaten the future of the human race. Sci-fi adventure, starring Tom Cruise and Morgan Freeman

programme.title: American Reunion (2012)
programme.desc: Jim Levenstein and his old friends return to their home town for a high-school reunion. Struck by how much their lives have changed, they set out to relive the sexual misadventures of their adolescence, but only end up making bigger fools of themselves than they did as teenagers. Comedy sequel to the American Pie movies, starring Jason Biggs and Alyson Hannigan

programme.title: First Dates
programme.desc: A beauty queen bricklayer goes looking for love with a bar manager, while two students with very different priorities when it comes to conversation try to make a connection. programme.title: Below Deck: Mediterranean

programme.title: Below Deck: Mediterranean

programme.title: First Dates

However, the pair are overwhelmed when a destructive giant bunny arrives on the scene, while an interfering aristocrat contrives to make matters worse. Nick Park's Oscar-winning animated adventure, with the voices of Peter Sallis, Ralph Fiennes and Helena Bonham Carter

programme.title: The Cinema List: Family Favourites
programme.desc: Discover some of the very best Sky Originals to watch with the whole family, from Monster Family to The Amazing Maurice

programme.title: The Lord of the Rings: The War of the Rohirrim (2024)
programme.desc: Helm Hammerhand sits on the throne of Rohan, flanked by sons Hama and Haleth and rebellious daughter Hera. Dunlending lord Freca proposes a marital union between Hera and his son Wulf, which Helm loudly rejects. In a subsequent brawl between fathers, Helm unintentionally lands a fatal blow, so Wulf vows revenge and amasses an army led by General Targg. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Gaia Wise, Brian Cox, Luke Pasqualino and Lorraine Ashbourne

programme.title: Dr Seuss' The Lorax (2012)
programme.desc: A boy leaves his urban home in search of a real tree, and meets the reclusive industrialist who first created the city. The hermit tells the story of a grumpy forest creature who tried to stop him destroying the trees, and inspires the youngster to undo the damage that has been done. Animated fantasy based on the children's book, with the voices of Danny DeVito, Zac Efron and Ed Helms

programme.desc: A race of strange, babbling yellow creatures has served the cause of evil throughout the history of the world. In the 1960s, three of these eternal henchmen get a job working for a criminal genius who is hatching a plot against the British crown - but while carrying out her orders, they uncover a threat to their whole species. Animated comedy, with the voices of Sandra Bullock, Pierre Coffin, Jon Hamm and Michael Keaton

programme.title: How to Train Your Dragon (2010)
programme.desc: A clumsy Viking boy longs to become a mighty dragon slayer and protect his village from the fearsome flying lizards, but his father thinks he is not up to the task. However, when he sets out to prove his worth, he ends up befriending a dragon, and realises his people may have misjudged the creatures. Animated fantasy, with the voices of Jay Baruchel and Gerard Butler

programme.title: How to Train Your Dragon 2 (2014)

Animated sequel, featuring the voices of Patton Oswalt, Kevin Hart and Harrison Ford

Animated musical, with the voices of Anna Kendrick and Justin Timberlake

Hired by a ruthless TV producer to locate the culprit, he discovers the mysterious man is not all he seems - but is soon distracted by the intervention of old acquaintance Carla Borrego. Offbeat detective drama, starring Alan Davies, Julia Sawalha and Adrian Edmondson

programme.title: Father Brown
programme.desc: The clerical sleuth investigates staff at the local health spa when an ex-employee is found murdered. Crime drama based on the stories by GK Chesterton, with Mark Williams

programme.title: New Tricks
programme.desc: Back in 1983, 16-year-old Amy Taskerland was murdered on the night of the school disco. More than 30 years later, the unearthing of a time capsule and the discovery of her voice on a mix tape inside prompts Miller and co to delve back into the case, starting by interviewing Amy's best friend Harriet and her former teacher Mr Hines. The recording features a strange mix of music and poetry, including words from a speech written in secret for the Queen for broadcast in the event of a nuclear war. But how did Amy get a copy of it, and was its secret nature the reason she was killed? Elsewhere, Miller enjoys her first romance since her divorce, while Gerry goes on his future son-in-law's stag night. Amy Nuttall (Emmerdale, Downton Abbey) and Jack Shepherd (Wycliffe) guest star

programme.title: New Tricks
programme.desc: Part one of two. Gerry is spooked by the discovery of UCOS's latest victim - a cop, whose body has lain untouched under a basement for 30 years. As accusations of police corruption and underhand dealings begin to surface, Gerry has to face up to some skeletons in his own closet and it's a race against time for the team to help before his murky past catches up with him. While babysitting his grandson, Gerry becomes convinced that only he holds the key to the investigation and goes Awol to uncover the truth. Starring Dennis Waterman and Denis Lawson

programme.title: Miss Marple
programme.sub-title: The Mirror Crack'd from Side to Side
programme.desc: A film star arrives from America and throws a summer garden party for the entire village of St Mary Mead - where one of her fans drinks a poisoned cocktail and promptly drops dead. Fortunately, the guest list includes Miss Marple, who immediately sets about tracking down the killer. Feature-length drama, starring Joan Hickson, Claire Bloom and Barry Newman

programme.title: The Brokenwood Mysteries
programme.desc: Detective Inspector Mike Shepherd is sent to the New Zealand town of Brokenwood to investigate the death of a farmer, after his body is found by two local fishermen. As he uncovers a family's tragedies and secrets, he also learns that Brokenwood is a place where shadows lurk just beneath the surface. Drama, starring Neill Rea, Fern Sutherland, Pana Hema Taylor and Nic Sampson

programme.title: Wallander
programme.desc: Drama based on the best-selling books by Henning Mankell, starring Kenneth Branagh as a Swedish detective recently estranged from his wife and struggling to readjust while fighting a rising tide of violence. Inspector Kurt Wallander searches for a link between three apparently motiveless murders, and tries to identify a girl who doused herself in petrol and burned to death. With Sarah Smart and Sadie Shimmin

programme.desc: David Attenborough uses advanced surveillance technology to observe the feeding habits of herbivores, including elephants forced to undertake epic migrations to ensure a steady diet of the plants they need to survive. programme.title: The Life of Mammals
programme.desc: David Attenborough examines the world of rodents, whose constantly growing incisor teeth are used to chisel through any obstacle and range from squirrels and the English harvest mouse to the large South American capybara. He looks at examples of their dental prowess, showing how agoutis in Panama break open rock-hard nutshells and the skills employed by beavers in Wyoming as they fell massive trees to build dams rivalling feats of human engineering

programme.title: The Life of Mammals
programme.desc: David Attenborough examines the hunting tactics of the world's carnivores. Arctic foxes in the frozen north must collect food during warmer times to survive the winter, while the big cats of the southern hemisphere rely on stealth and surprise to catch each meal. The presenter also reveals how leopards and tigers are solitary hunters, coming together only to mate, whereas lions stay in family groups so they can tackle larger prey and better protect their young

Similarly, the midwife toad became the centre of a scientific storm in the 1920s that led to accusations of fakery

programme.title: Operation Gold Rush with Dan Snow

programme.title: Operation Gold Rush with Dan Snow

programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The One with Ross's Library Book

programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The One Where Chandler Doesn't Like Dogs

programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The One with All the Candy

programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The One with the Holiday Armadillo
programme.desc: Phoebe plans to return to her flat and tries desperately to persuade Rachel to join her, while Monica is infuriated by Chandler's inability to tip appropriately. Ross looks after Ben during the holiday season, and dresses as an armadillo to keep him entertained

programme.title: In for a Penny
programme.desc: Stephen Mulhern heads to Barry in the Vale of Glamorgan for the game show in which he travels around the UK setting members of the public unusual challenges, giving them the chance to win anything from the price of their petrol to £1,000 in the final game.

programme.title: How to Lose Weight Well
programme.sub-title: From the Hallelujah to the Weigh Down Diet
programme.desc: Xand van Tulleken and Helen Lawal oversee proceedings as three more pairs road test some of the most popular and talked about diets. Drag queens Jordan and Thomas have one week to drop a dress size ahead of their next performance, best friends Earl and Vince go on six-week faith-based diets to slim down before a forthcoming church celebration, and mums Maria and Jules want to lose weight for a kayaking trip in three months. Xand also investigates whether infrared can make people lighter and if it is possible to offset snacks by exercising at work

programme.title: My Hoarder Mum and Me
programme.desc: A Place in the Sun presenter Jasmine Harman embarks on a personal journey to help her mother Vasoulla overcome her extreme hoarding habit. Over the course of 30 years, the family's five-bedroom London home has become filled from floor to ceiling with clutter, forcing Jasmine's 12-year-old brother Cameron to move out. Debate still rages over whether hoarding should be classified as a mental illness, and Jasmine meets the families of other sufferers to learn how they deal with the problem. Narrated by Rupert Houseman

programme.title: Celebrity Catchphrase
programme.desc: Stephen Mulhern hosts another charity edition of the game show, with Mel Blatt, Michelle Visage and Seann Walsh trying to say what they see as they guess well-known phrases for the chance to win a £50,000 jackpot for their chosen good causes

programme.title: Posh Pawn
programme.desc: More customers arrive at Prestige Pawnbrokers, including a woman and her son, who are hoping to secure a loan against a 71-carat tanzanite ring they bought from a home-shopping channel. Prestige boss James Constantinou takes a shine to a bespoke show motorbike, and must fight against his instinct to claim the vehicle for himself as he seeks a buyer. Plus, a collection of 500 handbags arrives for valuation

programme.title: Beat the Chasers
programme.desc: Bradley Walsh hosts as more studio audience members are called down to play against arguably the most formidable quiz team on TV. First up is a cash builder of up to five questions, after which they have the option of playing between two, three, four or all of the Chasers for increasing amounts of money - and those brave enough to take on all five could walk away with a huge cash prize
